title: Undergraduate Research Assistant
description:
* Designed the schematic and layout for a two-layer rigid-flex PCB for wearable core body temperature estimation, integrating ECG, photoplethysmography (PPG), temperature sensing, and Bluetooth Low Energy (BLE) connectivity.
* Sized the flex dielectric thickness for a 50 Ω controlled-impedance RF trace from the microcontroller to the BLE antenna.
* Leading development of a wearable 64-channel EMG acquisition PCB in KiCad to collect hand-motion data for training a neural network to reconstruct muscle activity from fewer channels. Designed the analog front end to amplify millivolt-scale EMG signals before multiplexing to limit signal loss.
company: Yeo Research Group at Georgia Tech
